title: Riesz 2-energy of the Diamond ensemble
summary: We study the Riesz $2$-energy of point configurations on the two-dimensional sphere arising from the Diamond ensemble, a construction of well-distributed points introduced by Beltrán and Etayo in 2020. For this family of point sets, we derive an explicit formula for the expected $2$-energy, valid for general choices of the parameters. Using this formula, we analyze a specific realization of the Diamond ensemble and obtain the asymptotic expansion of its expected $2$-energy.
